AT0061.title: API Automated Abuse Tools
AT0061.description: API automated abuse tools are a collection of tools specifically targeting Web API interfaces for automated attacks and abuse. These tools can automatically discover and enumerate API endpoints, bypass API rate limits and authentication mechanisms, and batch-call API interfaces for data scraping or business logic abuse. Main functions include API endpoint discovery and enumeration, authentication bypass (token forgery, JWT attacks, OAuth abuse), rate limit bypass (IP rotation, distributed requests, parameter mutation), and business logic abuse (bulk registration, bulk ordering, price tampering).

AT0061-001.title: API Enumeration and Authorization Testing Tool
AT0061-001.description: Automation for enumerating API paths, parameters, object IDs, and authorization boundaries.
keywords: API Enumeration and Authorization Testing Tool

AT0061-002.title: Webhook Replay Tool
AT0061-002.description: Tooling that captures, modifies, and replays webhook events to test signature verification and idempotency defects.

AT0061-003.title: SaaS OAuth Abuse Tool
AT0061-003.description: Tools for inducing authorization, enumerating SaaS permissions, and exporting mail or drive data at scale.

AT0061-004.title: Payment Fraud Automation Tool
